title: Divergence: thermite-tv ref_encode mis-encodes Index-arg combinators (forall_below/forall_from) — int index arg gets spurious @-view, faithful clause is a type error

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at thermite-tv/tests/divergence_index_combinator.rs::ref_encode_index_arg_not_slice_viewed demonstrates the divergence. ref_encode::encode_combinator_call routes every combinator arg through encode_slice_arg, which appends @ to any bare non-seq-bound Path. For forall_below(xs, n, |x| x<=7) — registry arg_kinds [Slice, Index, Pred], n: int — the int index arg is encoded as n@, a Verus type error (no view on int). Confirmed against real verus 0.2026.05.24: the faithful obligation does not even compile. Slice+pred combinators (forall_in/exists_in/count_where) generalize correctly; only the Index-arg combinators (forall_below/forall_from) are mis-encoded — the encoder is overfit to F2's shape. Authority: contract-tv.md REQ-1 (covers all 8 frozen combinators) + thermite-design.md §4.2 (frozen registry). Test is #[ignore]d pending fix (R-DEFER-3); fails when run with --ignored.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Plan: pin the divergence as a #[ignore]d failing test at thermite-tv/tests/divergence_index_combinator.rs asserting ref_encode does not slice-@-view the int Index arg of forall_below/forall_from. Critic does not fix — generator must root-cause in encode_combinator_call (dispatch arg encoding by the registry arg_kinds: Slice->@-view, Index->as int scalar, Pred->closure). Commit the failing test only.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Fixed in d7344ae. Root cause: encode_combinator_call routed EVERY combinator arg through encode_slice_arg, appending the slice @-view to bare Paths, so forall_below/forall_from's int index arg n became n@ (a Verus type error: no view on int), a silent wrong encoding (contract-tv.md REQ-1). Fix (single file thermite-tv/src/ref_encode.rs): encode_combinator_call now consults the matched CombinatorSig.arg_kinds and dispatches the i-th arg via encode_combinator_arg per kind: Slice to @-view, Index to scalar (n as int, no @), Pred to closure, Value as-is. Covers all 8 frozen combinators by kind. Verified against real verus: forall_below/forall_from faithful obligations COMPILE and verify (1 verified, 0 errors); infidel gives counterexample (0 verified, 1 errors). Un-ignored pin ref_encode_index_arg_not_slice_viewed PASSES; teeth F1-F4 green. Gauntlet: cargo test --workspace 318 passed 0 failed; clippy -D warnings PASS; fmt --check PASS.
